changelog: Restored hands-free Jarvis voice assistant: voice orb overlay, wake phrase, task management, and tile service adapted for AGY and Local models.
Integrated Jarvis MCP preset and bridge server routing for voice-controlled app operations.
Added intelligent message queue: messages sent while AI is working are queued and auto-sent when generation finishes.
Queue action controls: ✏️ Edit (removes from queue into text box), ⚡ Send Immediately (interrupts with smart continuation vs new task reasoning directive), and ✕ Delete.
